Sourdough starter smells like acetone

wren

My starter smells like nail polish remover after two days in the fridge. Is it ruined, or just hungry?

basil

Just hungry. The acetone smell means the yeast ran out of food. Feed it twice at room temperature and it will bounce back.

odile

Agree with basil. If it still smells after three feedings, discard all but a tablespoon and rebuild it with fresh rye flour.
